name: Isambard AI Skills
description: AI agent skills for Isambard HPC systems

skills.name: BriCS Responsible AI Code
skills.description: Guidance for writing, reviewing, and running AI-generated code responsibly on BriCS shared HPC resources (Isambard-AI and Isambard 3), including Slurm job scripts, storage awareness, BriCS policy compliance, and safe use of AI coding agents with Isambard.

skills.name: Containers
skills.description: Run containers on Isambard using Podman-HPC and Apptainer (formerly Singularity). Covers pulling, building, and migrating images, GPU access, single-node and multi-node MPI/NCCL workloads over Slingshot 11, and aarch64 image selection.

skills.name: Data Transfer
skills.description: Transfer data to, from, and between BriCS Isambard facilities. Covers the standard scp/rsync-over-SSH workflow via clifton, submitting large transfers as Slurm jobs, and the early-access data mover S3 staging service (rclone, AWS CLI, and Netham).

skills.name: Distributed Training
skills.description: Train, fine-tune and serve models across GPUs and nodes on Isambard-AI. Covers multi-node PyTorch DDP with srun and NCCL, LLM pre-training with Megatron Bridge, QLoRA fine-tuning with TRL, and vLLM serving on one or more nodes with Ray.

skills.name: Getting Support
skills.description: Get help with Isambard-AI and Isambard 3 through the BriCS helpdesk. Covers checking service status and known issues first, raising a support ticket at support.isambard.ac.uk, and what to include in a ticket.

skills.name: GPUs and CUDA
skills.description: Use GPUs and CUDA on Isambard-AI (NVIDIA GH200, sm_90). Covers loading cudatoolkit/nvhpc modules, compiling with nvcc -arch=sm_90, and CUDA forward compatibility for newer CUDA versions via NGC containers, NVIDIA HPC SDK, or conda cuda-compat.

skills.name: Interactive Sessions
skills.description: Run interactive sessions on Isambard compute nodes. Covers JupyterHub on Isambard-AI Phase 2, JupyterLab as a Slurm job with an SSH tunnel, custom Jupyter kernels from Conda or virtual environments, and VS Code remote tunnels.

skills.name: Logging In
skills.description: Log in to Isambard-AI, Isambard 3 and BlueCrystal 5 over SSH with Clifton. Covers first-time portal setup, the permanent UNIX short name, clifton auth and ssh-config, the 12-hour SSH certificate, login node rules and resource limits, and common login errors.

skills.name: ML Packages
skills.description: Install and run GPU-accelerated machine learning packages on Isambard-AI. Covers PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, Flash-Attention and vLLM with pip, Conda or NGC containers, AlphaFold 2 with ColabFold and MMseqs2, and BriCS shared datasets and models.

skills.name: Modules
skills.description: Use the modules system, Cray Programming Environments (PrgEnv-gnu, PrgEnv-cray), compiler wrappers (cc, CC, ftn), GNU and NVIDIA compilers, and profiling tools (gprof, Cray perftools, Nsight) on Isambard.

skills.name: MPI
skills.description: Use MPI on Isambard with Cray MPICH, OpenMPI, or conda-installed MPI. Covers PrgEnv loading, PMI types (cray_shasta, pmi2, pmix), srun --mpi flags, libfabric and Slingshot 11 performance, and why mpirun/mpiexec must not be used.

skills.name: NCCL
skills.description: Use NCCL for multi-node GPU communication on Isambard-AI over Slingshot 11. Covers the brics/nccl module, aws-ofi-nccl plugin, Slingshot environment variables, building NCCL from source, benchmarking with nccl-tests, and NCCL in Apptainer containers.

skills.name: Projects and Accounting
skills.description: Understand node hour (NHR) accounting on Isambard-AI and Isambard 3 and manage projects. Covers how job charges are calculated, NHR versus GPU hours, checking budget and usage in the BriCS and Awards Portals, running out of node hours, project roles, inviting and removing members, follow-on projects, and requesting extensions.

skills.name: Python
skills.description: Install and manage Python environments on Isambard using Conda (Miniforge), uv, or Cray Python. Covers virtual environments, building aarch64 packages from source, compiler flags, mpi4py, and finding arm64-compatible packages.

skills.name: Slurm
skills.description: Submit, monitor, and manage HPC jobs using the Slurm workload manager on Isambard systems. Includes guidance on resource allocation, job scripts, and safe polling intervals.

skills.name: Spack
skills.description: Install, configure, and use Spack to build HPC software on Isambard-AI and Isambard 3. Covers the buildit config repository, Spack environments, concretizing, installing, and targeting neoverse_v2 / aarch64.

skills.name: Storage
skills.description: Use storage on Isambard-AI and Isambard 3. Covers the storage areas ($HOME, $SCRATCHDIR, $PROJECTDIR, $PROJECTDIR_PUBLIC, $LOCALDIR), quotas and checking usage, data retention and deletion, sharing data, packaging many-file datasets with SquashFS, and detecting the system with ISAMBARD_HOST.
